summary: Static HUD values are exact: 1,611 samples over three autopilot races at 1280x720, 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 matched place, of, timer, km/h, HP, SP, KO, coins, km-left and cooldown seconds against the session (the only diffs were my own rounding). Tags track head anchors within 0-1 px, fade 15-25 m and hide on invisible/crash/behind-camera. Every listed cut-in fired on its real event: countdown, skill band, rival chips, SHOWTIME, KO/DOUBLE, WRECKED (KO and traffic), BUSTED, FINISH+place, PERFECT, DRIFT, NEAR MISS, SLIPSTREAM/SLINGSHOT, ONE MORE!, place, FINAL STRETCH and pickups. Pause and restart re-attach cleanly, there were no console errors, and perf is excellent (update 0.16 ms avg / 0.4 ms max, 0 no-op attribute writes, ~122 fps). But the HUD shows wrong information in common situations: a stolen weapon's uses, merged callouts with stale text ('DRIFT L2 一段', '▼ 7TH 超车！'), a made-up '+4S' penalty, a POLICE warning when there are no police, and intro cards naming riders the camera isn't on. Taunt bubbles also stack over each other and over the name tags in every pack. Below a commercial bar.

issues.title: Weapon slot shows full uses after stealing or picking up a worn weapon
issues.detail: src/ui/hud/weapon.ts set()/picked() reset uses to WEAPONS[w].uses on every combat:weaponPick, but combat transfers the remaining uses (armory.ts takeWeapon -> equip(a, weapon, uses); pickups.ts giveWeapon(it.uses)). Real test v2/t7-weapon.mjs: rival given a baguette with 2/6 uses, player steals it with a heavy hit -> HUD 法棍 6 pips vs combat.data(0).uses = 2; after 1 hit HUD 5 vs real 1; the 2nd hit breaks it while the HUD still shows 5 pips, and the is-last blink never fired (v2/crop-t7-weapon.png, v2/t7.log). The player starts unarmed, so stealing is the main way to get a weapon: the readout is wrong most of the time it matters.
issues.fix: Track uses per rider from events the bus already carries: decrement the attacker on every unblocked melee combat:hit (skillId null, any rider), transfer the victim's count on combat:weaponPick.stolenFrom, remember {weapon, uses} on combat:weaponDrop for the matching pickup, crate = full. Keep the core request (uses on combat:weaponPick / RiderState.weaponUses) and switch to it once it lands. Never show an invented full bar: show '?' until the count is known.

issues.title: Merged callouts keep the first callout's Chinese line and up/down style
issues.detail: cutins/callouts.ts push(): on a same-key merge fill() only rewrites .co-en and --dc. .co-cn and the mod class keep their first values. Seen in real play: a drift through the coast bend reads 'DRIFT L2 | 一段' (v2/t4-1920x1080-drift.png; L3 would read 'DRIFT L3 一段'); a pass followed by being passed reads '▼ 7TH 超车！' in the white 'up' style (v2/crop-t3-callout.png, again in v2/t8-1920x1080-cast-ahead.png as '▼ 8TH 超车！'); SLIPSTREAM merges into 'SLINGSHOT! 跟住尾流' instead of 尾流弹射 (autopilot race v2/t1-1920x1080-s4.json f2374). Every L2/L3 drift and every pass-then-passed shows wrong text.
issues.fix: On merge rebuild the item text: cn text and display, remove the old spec.mod class and add the new one, respect the ransom flag. Add a sandbox scene that fires drift 1->2->3 and placeChange up->down within 1 s and asserts the DOM text.

issues.title: Taunt bubbles pile up on each other and cover the rival name tags
issues.detail: world/bubbles.ts places a bubble at the raw head projection minus a fixed 66k px. It ignores the tag's de-overlap lift (tags.ts t.lift) and other bubbles, and every off-screen speaker docks at the same clamp point. Real race: 3 bubbles stacked over each other and over the 咕咕/神烦狗/卡皮 tags (v2/crop-t3-bubbles.png). Autopilot f700: 滑总's bubble hides the 滑总 tag (with its 雨伞 chip) and the 哈基米 tag, both reported visible at opacity 1 (v2/crop-f700-tags.png). With the cat 2.5 m ahead, two bubbles and their speaker labels overlap (v2/t8-1920x1080-cast-ahead.png). Two speakers behind the camera on the right both dock at translate(1730px, 650px) and one is fully hidden (v2/t8-1920x1080-bubbles-behind.png). Pack riding at every race start triggers this; the brief says overlays must never pile up unreadably.
issues.fix: Run one layout pass for tags and bubbles: anchor a bubble above its speaker's drawn tag top (t.y - t.lift - tag height), then de-overlap bubbles against each other and against visible tags (push up or sideways, nearest speaker wins). Stack docked bubbles per side. Cap visible bubbles near the road centre at 2 and queue the farthest.

issues.title: BUSTED '+4S' penalty is invented by the HUD and contradicts the real time
issues.detail: events.ts adds BUSTED_PENALTY on police:busted, place.ts then shows '+4S' next to TIME for the rest of the race, and the splash says 罚时 +4S. The race unit's penalty IS the 4 s ticket stop (police.ts: 'the penalty is the ticket stop itself': mode 'busted', speed 0 for 4 s), and finishTime/results are not increased. v2/t6-finish.mjs: busted, then finished -> HUD 'TIME 0:21.85 +4S' while finishTime = results.time = 21.855 (v2/t6-1920x1080-after.png). During the 4 s hold the HUD shows nothing once the 1.1 s splash ends (v2/t5-1920x1080-hold-60.png).
issues.fix: Remove addPenalty and the persistent +NS tag. While player.mode === 'busted', show a ticket countdown next to the timer (罚停 3..2..1). Change the splash sub to '罚款 100 小鱼干 · 靠边 4 秒'. Only show a time penalty if race/results expose one.

issues.title: POLICE warning (siren glow + 柯基警官出没 chip) shows when no police exist
issues.detail: world/edges.ts update() computes want = max(alertLevel, heat*0.8). So whenever player.heat > 0.5 the glow and the chip appear, even where the corgi cannot spawn (last 10 % of the track, 20 s cooldown after a chase). v2/t5-police.mjs: at 91 % with setHeat(0.95), __br.race.police() reports mode 'off' with gap 3040 m, yet glow opacity is 0.59 and chip opacity 1 (v2/t5-1920x1080-false-alarm.png). After an aggressive race this false alarm sits through the whole final stretch, since heat cools only 0.012-0.036/s.
issues.fix: Drive glow and chip only from police:alert (0 off, 1 chase, 2 alongside). If a heat pre-warning is wanted, make it a separate heat meter whose wording never claims the officer is present.

issues.title: Intro calling cards name riders the race camera isn't showing
issues.detail: cutins/intro.ts shows each rival once. When no unshown rival is in view it cycles the grid every 0.75 s (nextInGrid), which forces 6 cards into a 3 s flyover while the race camera presents 3-4 riders. Sampled every 5 frames against race's IntroCamera.focus() (whose doc says it exists 'for intro name cards'): the card matched in 4 of 35 samples (v2/t10.log). At f155 the card is 滑总 while the camera frames the shiba and the pigeon, and the penguin is hidden behind the card itself (v2/t10-1920x1080-intro-2.png). The brief asks for one card per rival as the camera passes.
issues.fix: Core request: a race->HUD 'race:introFocus' {riderId} event (race already computes focus()). Until it exists, only card the rival actually framed (on-screen, small depth, near the screen centre), allow repeats, never fall back to off-camera riders, and change the card only when the subject changes.

issues.title: Player skill band stays up under WRECKED/BUSTED splashes
issues.detail: cutins/director.ts splashIn() ends the band only for priority >= ko (8); WRECKED and BUSTED are 7. Autopilot race f2477-2513: a torpedo cast followed 0.1 s later by a wreck leaves the FISH TORPEDO band and eyes strip visible behind and above the WRECKED splash (v2/t1-1920x1080-s4-f2500.png): two cut-ins stacked.
issues.fix: End the band for any splash with priority >= wrecked, or when the player crashes, and ignore bandIn while such a splash is up.

issues.title: Distance-to-go is covered by the player's own badge in the final stretch
issues.detail: In progress.ts/progress.css the 50 px player badge rides the bar at p*760 px, and .pg-dist sits under the bar's right end. From about 80 % progress the badge covers the top half of the km digits: 91 % reads '0.2? KM' (v2/crop-t5-km.png) and the finish reads '0.00' half-hidden (v2/t6-1920x1080-after.png). The YOU tag is hidden past 88 % but the badge is not, and this is exactly when the number matters.
issues.fix: Move the km readout outside the badge's path (right of the flag, or below the bar end), or lift the player badge above the bar when p > 0.8.

issues.title: Skill-cast warning chevron points at the screen edge for casters right in front
issues.detail: edges.ts updateChev() draws any hot rival with ds in [-0.8, 4) at the left or right screen edge (x = 70k or w-70k, rot ±90°) by sign(dx), even when the rider is in plain view ahead. v2/t8-edges.mjs: 哈基米 pinned 2.5 m ahead at dx -0.34 casts OIIA SPIN, and a '转 !' chevron appears at translate(70px, 605px) on the left edge while the cat and its tag are centre screen (v2/t8-1920x1080-cast-ahead.png, v2/crop-t8-sidechev.png).
issues.fix: Use the projector: show edge chevrons only when the rider projects off-screen or behind the camera. For an on-screen caster, flash its name tag (hot outline + skill glyph) instead.

issues.title: Callouts raised at a KO are swallowed by the cinematic
issues.detail: cutins/layer.ts dims the callout stack to 0 during a cinematic, but callouts.ts keeps ageing the items. v2/t11-combo.mjs case B (a combo whose 3rd hit is the KO): ONE MORE! shows at 58 % for one sample, fades to 0 within 0.1 s, and is removed just as cine:ko end arrives (v2/t11.log f961-f1036). The SP bonus feedback is never readable; place callouts from the KO'd rival dropping back are lost the same way.
issues.fix: Freeze callout and banner lifetimes while calm < 1, or re-push them when the cinematic ends, so they play after the KNOCK OUT splash.

issues.title: Progress strip labels every 'down' rider as KO (crashes, BUSTED)
issues.detail: progress.ts sets is-down for mode 'crashed' or 'busted', and progress.css .pg-h.is-down::before always prints 'KO'. Wall and traffic crashes and the BUSTED stop all read as KO, including the player's own badge during the ticket stop (v2/crop-t5-busted-badge.png).
issues.fix: Use one class per cause: KO for combat:ko victims, ✕/WRECK for other crashes (rider:crash cause), 罚/BUSTED for mode busted.

issues.title: Incoming-projectile warning ignores projectile:spawn/end, which now exist
issues.detail: At the HUD's request, core added projectile:spawn {id, owner, target, kind, pos} and projectile:end to events-map, and combat emits them (projectiles.ts). world/overlay.ts never subscribes: edges.ts only flashes chevrons on skill:cast, and status/ui-hud.md still says 'no projectile event exists'. A homing torpedo aimed at the player (e.g. a pelican rival via ?rivals=) gets no tracked warning.
issues.fix: On projectile:spawn with target === player.id, show a tracked warning at the projectile's projected or edge-clamped position with time-to-impact. Clear it on projectile:end and update the status file.
